## Biography

Rafik Ghali is an artificial intelligence researcher at the Université de Moncton. His research focuses on computer vision, deep learning, multimodal AI, generative AI, and data analysis, with applications in
wildfire monitoring. His work includes wildfire detection and segmentation, synthetic data generation, and wildfire risk mapping. He also explores embedded AI solutions for real-time applications.
